structured.answer: Open an account at Psagot (פסגות) and buy the "אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)" fund, number 5112628. The page marks that combination "הזול" (the cheapest): 86,045 ₪ left after 10 years, and the next-best option leaves about 1,030 ₪ less. I'm fairly sure, but it ran on its own example of 10,000 ₪ plus 500 a month, not my 30,000.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the inputs at the top
stuck.why: It's set to 10,000 ₪ today and 500 a month. That isn't my 30,000, and I didn't touch it. Is the answer the same for my amount? No idea.
The big pink piece, 5,555, is the biggest cost. The legend is a row further down. I guessed pink = מס (tax), but I had to look back and forth to match it.

stuck.where: Screen 3, the step chart 'מנקודת התחלה ועד הכי הרבה'
stuck.why: It starts from 'עכשיו 79,910' with הראל סל at Jerusalem bank. I never chose that, so where did 'now' come from? Lost me for a second.
Every fund has a minus, -0.04%, -0.28%... Does minus mean losing money? It scared me a bit, but the chosen one has the smallest minus.
Psagot's account is 1,049 ₪ over 10 years and לאומי's is 4,506, yet the totals are only about 3,000 apart. Didn't get why, didn't check.
